title: Tyler reverse-engineering UFO crash debris

tellings.quote: said that they had acquired debris from UFO crash sites and that he was reverse engineering these and they were creating this technology kind of gamechanging technology

plain: A scholar named Diana Pasulka, who wrote a book called American Cosmic, says a man she calls Tyler, who worked in the US space program, told her that his group had gotten hold of debris from UFO crash sites. According to her, Tyler said he was studying those pieces to learn how they worked and copy them, and that this was producing game-changing technology, which would mean human inventions are being built from crashed craft.
